metadata.description: Reduck Agents — reference agents that package skills and the Reduck MCP to perform complex tasks in your own browser.

plugins.name: reduck-geo
plugins.description: Get your site cited by Claude. Shows which queries Claude searches, then checks Brave — the index behind its web search — to tell you whether your pages can be read, whether Brave has them at all, or whether they are simply ranked too low, and which one to fix first.

plugins.name: reduck-invoices
plugins.description: Fetch and download invoices for paid SaaS: a per-host list_invoices script returns each invoice URL, then a generic download step routed on the URL's domain fetches the PDF.
